name: Nutech Global Limited
summary: Nutech Global Ltd. operates within the textile sector, focusing on the production of a diverse range of fabrics. Its product line encompasses materials such as viscose, cotton, woolen polyester, Lycra, and various stretch fabrics. The company was founded by Shyam Sunder Mukhija on June 8, 1984, and its main corporate office is situated in Bhilwara, India.
